description: Henter avgrenset områdesignering, EQCR-, partnergjennomgangs- og beretningsstatus for én eksplisitt oppdrags-ID. Dette er ikke en faglig godkjenning.

oppdrag_id.description: Eksplisitt oppdrags-ID fra Revly. Oppslag uten ID er ikke tillatt.

name: hent_signoff_status

outputSchema.description: Signing and review status for one engagement. Not a professional approval.

signert.description: True only when the report is signed.

signert_dato.description: Report signing date, null unless the report is signed.

eqcr.description: EQCR status. This is not a professional approval.

anyOf.description: Minimal evidence that this read was recorded.

client_receipt.description: Whether the connected client confirmed receipt. Revly reports "unknown".

result_produced.description: True when Revly produced the read result.

missing_sources.description: Sources with no record. Missing data stays visible and is never treated as a positive result.

signerte.description: Number of signatures in this group.

operation_id.description: Revly operation ID for this read, recorded in the access log.

revly_url.description: Link to the engagement in Revly.

items.description: Source manifest entry: what contributed to the result and how current it is.

group_count.description: Grouped signature rows, for grouped sources.

source.description: Source that contributed to the result, for example oppdrag+klienter or forespoersler.

version.description: Latest version marker as text. Null when Revly has no version.

sources.description: Sources that contributed to the result.

status.description: available, or not_recorded when no signature, review or report exists.

truncated.description: True when the area list was cut short.
